comment: Opened stacked iOS Reader Preview PR with 448/448 tests, iOS/macOS Release builds, and live coverage endpoint verification green.
Opened stacked V1 UI smoke repair PR after 29 UI tests completed with 7 expected fixture skips and 0 failures, 450 unit tests passed, macOS scaffold build passed, and strict preflight was green.
Opened Tier-3 auth durability PR stacked on #367; persistence, rollback, Apple JWKS isolation, and production fail-closed startup verified; review required, no self-merge.
Proposed Tier-3 local demo email login plus opt-in Keychain remembered credentials; Apple identity-token auth remains separate and production has no demo path.
Opened stacked Tier-3 local demo/Keychain auth PR; debug loopback only, Apple OAuth unchanged, reviewed tests green; no self-merge.

Independent adversarial auth-security and test/ops reviews completed. Findings fixed: production rejects uninitialized empty canonical auth, schema-only cannot authorize empty auth, pre-marker rollback is prohibited, Fly includes AUTH_APPLE_AUDIENCE, and future marker versions cannot be downgraded or imported over. Local focused 222/222, backend 2238 pass plus 1 skip, deterministic quality gate green. Tier-3; no self-merge.

Live Launch Doctor follow-up fixed millisecond session timestamps rendering as year 58625; rebuilt signed-in macOS app now shows Aug 27, 2026, remembered-login tests pass 26/26, and full iOS themTests pass 496/496. Tier-3/do-not-merge remains.

Authenticated Data Controls freeze reproduced as a SwiftUI/auth-session-queue lock inversion and repaired by caching recovery-owner scope outside view rendering plus deferring legacy-token defaults cleanup. Rebuilt live app remained responsive through Data Controls, Launch Doctor export, home, and Account; Studio smoke passed 1/5, focused tests 29/29, full iOS tests 497/497, and macOS Scaffold Debug build green. Tier-3/do-not-merge remains.

Opened Tier-2 local backend startup repair after live Launch Doctor smoke exposed a no-provider-key crash; development now boots and provider routes fail closed at request time, with 1217 backend tests passed and 1 skipped.

Opened Tier-2 current-main request-log security repair; replaces query-bearing URL logs with one route-template record, validates request IDs, and passes 13 focused plus 1231 backend tests. Independent cross-agent review is required before merge.

Tier-2 review blocked merge: request logger mounted after CORS missed early rejects, and finish-only emission missed client-aborted responses. Fixing middleware order plus finish/close once-guard with integration regressions before re-review.

Independent Tier-2 re-review at b7fe085 is non-blocking: logger precedes CORS, finish/close emit once, aborted health remains visible, CORS rejects use a neutral route, focused 16/16 and full backend 1234 pass with 1 skipped.
Merged Tier-2 PII-safe request logging under D005 after independent non-blocking re-review, 16 focused tests, 1234 backend passes with 1 skipped, and green GitHub evaluate.
Closed stale PII logging branch after stronger current-main replacement PR #372 merged; do not rebase or restore #365.

Closed divergent launch-safety PR as unsafe to merge wholesale: migration runner corrupts PL/pgSQL blocks and spend cap is not multi-instance atomic. Logging is superseded by #372; IDOR coverage is being ported separately.

Opened Tier-2 test-only current-main IDOR regression: two real users, four reads, six writes, exact DELETE guard, spoofed identity header, anonymous access, no secret leakage, and owner state intact; focused 1/1 and full backend 1235 pass with 1 skipped.

Tier-2 review blocked merge on one missing IDOR edge: collection POST accepts caller project_id. Add proof that Bob same-id upsert creates only a Bob-owned record, plus assert all owner sentinels and collaborator count remain unchanged.

Independent Tier-2 re-review at cc8531e approved: same-id collection upsert stays in Bob namespace, all four Alice sentinels are real and intact, counts remain exact, and all direct read/write/delete/header/anonymous checks are covered.
